LB::dst_tag
Description
Set the destination tag for the current request
Syntax
LB
::
dst_tag
"destination_tag"
LB::dst_tag <destination_tag>
Sets the destination tag for the current request. The tag can be just
a string. This tag will be used as destination key to look up the
target connection.
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
LB
::
dst_tag
"foo_tag"
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
CLIENT_DATA
SERVER_CONNECTED
SERVER_DATA
